# IMDb

> IMDb is the world's most popular and authoritative source for movies, TV shows, and entertainment, offering comprehensive databases, ratings, reviews, and curated interest guides across all genres and subgenres.

IMDb provides entertainment discovery through genre and subgenre interest pages, covering everything from mainstream films to niche categories like psychological horror and shōnen anime. The platform aggregates trending films, anime content, and entertainment events to help users explore content aligned with their interests.

## Key Topics

- Horror
- Psychological Horror
- Vampire Horror
- Action Epic
- Shōnen Anime
- Anime Movies
- Anime TV Shows

- IMDb Interest Categories

## Entertainment Events

- [All Events](https://m.imdb.com/event/all/?ref_=int_nv_menu): Directory of film festivals, award ceremonies, and entertainment events on IMDb.

## Horror & Thriller Genres

- [Horror](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000112/?ref_=ints_cat_12_in_i_5): Horror genre interest page featuring stories designed to elicit fear, suspense, and dread.
- [Psychological Horror](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000114/?ref_=ints_cat_12_in_i_7): Psychological horror subgenre interest page exploring tension, fear, and psychological dread in films.
- [Vampire Horror](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000119/?ref_=int_sim_in_i_11): Vampire horror subgenre interest guide exploring vampires as central figures of fear and fascination.

## Action & Adventure Genres

- [Action Epic](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000002/?ref_=int_sim_in_i_2): Action epic subgenre interest guide featuring grand narratives and heroic journeys across vast landscapes.

## Anime & Manga Adaptations

- [Shōnen](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000206/?ref_=int_sim_in_in_i_7): Shōnen anime interest guide featuring action-packed stories with themes of friendship and perseverance.
